paragraphs: Our mission is to unleash the potential of every team.
Atlassian's team collaboration software enables organizations to connect all teams through a system of work that unlocks productivity at scale.

Our deeply interconnected portfolio of apps, AI agents, and Collections, each with discrete value propositions, delivers solutions for software teams, IT operations and support teams, leadership and business teams. As an AI-first company, we have embedded AI capabilities across every surface of our platform, enabling organizations to orchestrate work effectively across both human and AI teammates. These apps, agents, and Collections are all built on the Atlassian Cloud Platform and data model: a common technology foundation that seamlessly connects teams, information, context, and workflows throughout an organization.

Since Atlassian was founded in Sydney, Australia in 2002, we've advanced our mission with a deep investment in product development to build innovative, high-value, and versatile apps that users love. Our software has been recognized as a leader in multiple markets and powers more than 350,000 customers worldwide. We serve organizations of all sizes, from small emerging companies to over 85% of the Fortune 500, across almost every industry, and in over 200 countries and territories.

Our product-led philosophy prioritizes delivering high-value, competitively priced software at high volume, enabling us to go to market in a unique and efficient way. We aim to grow our customer base, targeting small, medium, and large enterprises, and strategically expand our relationships with customers over time. To land new customers, we've engineered a frictionless flywheel with an emphasis on self-service, making it easy for customers to try and get value first and foremost and then virally expand within an organization. This allows our sales force to

focus primarily on expanding and deepening strategic relationships with our existing large enterprise customers, and also allows us to operate at an exceptional scale for an enterprise software company.

Our system of work is a philosophy of how organizations should work, connecting all teams to accelerate progress and maximize team impact by providing an AI-powered shared platform for managing workflows across the entire organization.

We deliver this system of work through a connected portfolio of apps, agents, and Collections with discrete value propositions, all built on the Atlassian platform. By connecting teams with these apps, agents, and Collections, the Atlassian system of work gives all teams the right foundations so they can align work to goals, plan and track work, coordinate workflows across departments, unleash knowledge across the organization, and, for our cloud customers, put AI at the center of how work gets done – enabling human and AI teammates to collaborate through a single, governed system of work.

The Atlassian Cloud Platform underpins our cloud app portfolio, allowing us to provide unified experiences, standardized data, and common enterprise infrastructure across all apps, agents, and teams. It is designed to break down information silos with cross-product experiences and flexible integrations, and ensures that data remains secure, compliant, private, and available with enterprise-grade centralized admin visibility and controls. It enables modern and connected experiences across teams, tools, workflows, and data, including capabilities like AI, search, and automation. The comprehensive data model, or Teamwork Graph, unifies and standardizes data across Atlassian apps, third-party tools, and teams, providing the rich organizational context that powers AI agents and cross-product workflows.

The infrastructure layer of the Atlassian Cloud Platform is purpose-built to meet the evolving needs of enterprise customers, delivering performance, scale, reliability, security, compliance, and privacy. It provides a secure, enterprise-grade foundation that supports large-scale environments, ensures data protection, and enables centralized administration and controls. This robust infrastructure allows Atlassian to continuously deliver new features, power AI workloads at scale, and maintain high standards for uptime and compliance across all cloud apps. The infrastructure layer includes our AI Gateway, which provides intelligent routing across multiple AI models designed to optimize performance, cost, and latency for different workloads, enabling us to deliver AI capabilities in a provider-agnostic, enterprise-grade manner.

The Teamwork Graph layer of the Atlassian Cloud Platform is an intelligent, unified data layer that connects contextualized teamwork data across Atlassian and non-Atlassian tools. It maps relationships between goals, knowledge, teams, and work, providing fine-grain context to powerfully enrich cross-product experiences that accelerate, align, and optimize work across organizations.

This organizational context is a critical enabler for effective AI agents and automated workflows. As AI models become increasingly commoditized, the quality of the context they operate on determines the quality of their output. The Teamwork Graph provides AI agents, whether built by Atlassian, our users, our customers, or third parties, with the relationship-aware enterprise context they need to produce accurate, relevant, and actionable results. Unlike general-purpose data repositories, the Teamwork Graph captures how people, projects, goals, and decisions connect to one another within and across teams, giving agents the ability to traverse established relationships rather than discover them from scratch.

The Teamwork Graph is self-reinforcing: it grows richer with each workflow, integration, and interaction, including those from third-party agents that connect through open protocols such as the Model Context Protocol ("MCP") and our command-line interface ("CLI"). This openness strengthens the graph, as external agents both consume and contribute organizational context, deepening the data layer with every interaction. The value of the Teamwork Graph compounds over time as customers add more workflows, data sources, and applications to their Atlassian environment.

Rovo is Atlassian's AI offering, designed for teamwork rather than individual productivity alone. Powered by the Teamwork Graph, Rovo provides AI capabilities with the organizational context — the relationships between people, projects, goals, and knowledge — needed to deliver accurate, relevant, and actionable results across an enterprise's connected workflows. headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Our historical rapid growth makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects, and we may not be able to sustain our revenue growth rate or achieve long-term profitability in the future.
The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be harmed.
Our AI offerings and investments may not be successful, which could adversely affect our business or financial results.
We may encounter challenges as we continue to transition our business to focus on Cloud offerings.
We may encounter challenges as we develop our sales force and sales strategy.

Our business model for our low-touch customers is based in part on a high volume of transactions and organic expansion. If this model is not effective, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
If we are unable to develop and maintain successful relationships with our solution partners, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be harmed.
Any failure to offer high-quality product support could harm our relationships with our customers and our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
We derive a majority of our revenue from Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.
Acquisitions, strategic investments or partnerships could disrupt our business, and we may be unable to integrate our acquisitions successfully or achieve the expected benefits of such transactions.
If we cannot continue to expand the use of our offerings beyond our initial focus on software developers, our ability to grow our business could be harmed.
If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brand, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be harmed.
If we fail to effectively manage our growth, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
If the Atlassian Marketplace does not continue to be successful, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
Risks Related to Information Technology, Intellectual Property, and Data Security and Privacy
Interruptions or performance problems associated with our technology and infrastructure could harm our business and results of operations.
paragraphs: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider such risks and uncertainties, together with the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, and in our other public filings. If any such risks and uncertainties actually occur, our business, financial condition or results of operations could differ materially from the plans, projections, and other forward-looking statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other public filings. In addition, if any of the following risks and uncertainties, or if any other risks and uncertainties, actually occur, our business, financial condition, or results of operations could be harmed substantially.

Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including those highlighted in this section titled "Risk Factors" and summarized below. We have various categories of risks, including risks related to our business and industry, risks related to information technology, intellectual property, data security and privacy, risks related to legal, regulatory, accounting, and tax matters, risks related to ownership of our Class A Common Stock, risks related to our indebtedness, and general risks, which are discussed more fully below. As a result, this risk factor summary does not contain all of the information that may be important to you, and you should read this risk factor summary together with the more detailed discussion of risks and uncertainties set forth following this summary, as well as elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
•Our historical rapid growth makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects, and we may not be able to sustain our revenue growth rate or achieve long-term profitability in the future.
•The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be harmed.
•Our AI offerings and investments may not be successful, which could adversely affect our business or financial results.
•We may encounter challenges as we continue to transition our business to focus on Cloud offerings.

paragraphs: This section of our Annual Report on Form 10-K discusses our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal years 2026 and 2025, and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2026 and 2025, in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP"). A discussion of our financial condition and results of operations for the fiscal year 2024 and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2025 and 2024 that is not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2025, filed on August 15, 2025.

You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and the related notes appearing under "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" in Item 8 in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. As discussed in the section titled "Forward-Looking Statements," the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties, as well as assumptions that, if they never materialize or prove incorrect, could cause our results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include, but are not limited to, those identified below, and those discussed in the section titled "Risk Factors" under Part I, Item 1A in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
Our mission is to unleash the potential of every team.
Atlassian's team collaboration software enables organizations to connect all teams through a system of work that unlocks productivity at scale.

Our deeply interconnected portfolio of apps, AI agents, and Collections, each with discrete value propositions, delivers solutions for software teams, IT operations and support teams, leadership and business teams. As an AI-first company, we have embedded AI capabilities across every surface of our platform, enabling organizations to orchestrate work effectively across both human and AI teammates. These apps, agents, and Collections are all built on the Atlassian Cloud Platform and data model: a common technology foundation that seamlessly connects teams, information, context, and workflows throughout an organization.

We generate revenues primarily in the form of subscription fees. Subscription revenues consist primarily of fees earned from subscription-based arrangements for providing customers the right to use our software apps in a cloud-based infrastructure that we provide ("Cloud offerings"). We also sell on-premises term license agreements for our Data Center products ("Data Center offerings"), consisting of software licensed for a specified period and support and maintenance services that are bundled with the license for the term of the license period. Subscription revenues also include subscription-based agreements for our premier support services. From time to time, we make changes to our apps and product offerings, prices, and pricing plans for our offerings, which may impact the growth rate of our revenue, and our deferred revenue balances, remaining performance obligations, and customer retention. Subscription revenue, through our Cloud and Data Center offerings, results in a large recurring revenue base.

In September 2025, we announced plans to end-of-life our Data Center offering. As of March 2026, we no longer sell term licenses to new customers, and we will stop selling term licenses and expansions to existing customers in March 2028. Subject to limited exceptions, we also plan to end maintenance and support for on-premises versions of our products in March 2029. In order to support customers who face unique requirements or challenges, we will offer an approximately three-year extended maintenance period for certain customers.

In the second quarter of fiscal year 2026, we completed the acquisitions of The Browser Company of New York Inc. ("BCNY") and A Software Company ("DX"). We believe integrating these technologies into our offerings will enhance customer value. BCNY has built a browser for enterprises optimized for SaaS applications in the AI-era. DX offers market-leading engineering intelligence that provides leaders with data-driven insights to understand how their investments are helping teams accelerate and improve their work and enhances the value of the offerings in our Collections.

Our results of operations may vary based on the impact of changes in the global economy on us or our customers. Our business depends on demand for business software applications generally and for collaboration software solutions in particular. We are subject to risks and exposures from the evolving macroeconomic environment, inflationary pressures, interest rate policy, changes in trade policies, political instability, and geopolitical tensions. We monitor the direct and indirect impacts of these circumstances on our business and financial results. The extent to which these risks ultimately impact our business, results of operations, and financial position will depend on future developments, which are uncertain and cannot be predicted at this time.

During the first quarter of fiscal year 2026, we initiated a restructuring plan to reduce capacity that was no longer necessary due to the increased ability, accessibility, performance, stability, and supportability of our products.

During the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, we initiated another restructuring plan to accelerate building the future of teamwork in the AI era. This includes self-funding further investment in key strategic priorities, such as AI and enterprise sales, reorganizing our teams to move with more focus and speed across the Atlassian System of Work, and optimizing for long-term operational efficiency and sustainability. This initiative resulted in the elimination of certain roles, which impacted approximately 10% of our workforce.
The execution of these actions, including cash payment of the severance and other termination benefits related liabilities, have been substantially satisfied as of June 30, 2026.
As a result, we recorded total severance and other termination benefits of $203.9 million, and additional stock-based compensation of $1.4 million for the affected employees during fiscal year 2026.

In addition, we exited certain leased properties to optimize our real estate footprint and have entered, or plan to enter, into sublease agreements for these locations. As a result, we recorded total impairment charges for the related operating lease right-of-use assets and leasehold improvements of $80.0 million for the fiscal year ended 2026.

不要輕視客戶 客戶是我們的命脈。沒有滿意的客戶，我們將無以為繼。因此，從客戶的角度出發 - 集體的，而非僅少數人 - 是首要考量。
paragraphs: 本公司之使命為啟發每一個團隊之潛能。
Atlassian 之團隊協作軟體使組織得以透過一系統化之工作流程，連結所有團隊，並在規模化之下提升生產力。

本公司深度連結之應用程式、AI 代理人與 Collections 產品組合，每項皆具備獨特之價值主張，提供軟體團隊、IT 運維與支援團隊、領導與業務團隊之解決方案。作為一間以 AI 為先導之公司，本公司已將 AI 能力內建於平台之各個層面，使組織得以有效協調人類與 AI 同事之間之工作。這些應用程式、代理人與 Collections 皆建於 Atlassian Cloud Platform 與資料模型之上：一個共通之科技基礎，可無縫連結組織內之團隊、資訊、脈絡與工作流程。
自 2002 年在澳洲雪梨成立以來，本公司持續深化使命，透過對產品開發之深度投資，打造創新、高價值且多功能之應用程式，深受用戶喜愛。本公司之軟體在多個市場被認可為領導者，並服務全球超過 35 萬個客戶。本公司服務於各規模之組織，從新興之小型企業至超過 85% 之財富 500 大企業，橫跨幾乎所有產業，並在超過 200 個國家與地區運作。
本公司以產品為導向之哲學，優先於交付高價值、具競爭力價格之軟體於高規模，使本公司得以以獨特且高效之方式進入市場。本公司旨在擴大客戶羣，目標為小型、中型與大型企業，並策略性地擴展與客戶之關係。為獲取新客戶，本公司已設計出一無摩擦之飛輪機制，強調自助服務，使客戶得以輕鬆試用並首先獲得價值，並在組織內進行病毒式擴張。此機制使本公司銷售團隊得以
主要專注於擴大與深化與現有大型企業客戶之戰略關係，同時使本公司得以運作於企業軟體公司之卓越規模。
本公司之系統化工作流程為組織應如何運作之哲學，透過連結所有團隊，加速進展並最大化團隊之影響力，提供一 AI 系統化平台，用以管理組織內之工作流程。

本公司透過一組連結之應用程式、AI 代理人與 Collections 產品組合，提供此係統化工作流程，每項皆具備獨特之價值主張，皆建於 Atlassian 平台之上。透過連結團隊與這些應用程式、AI 代理人與 Collections，Atlassian 之系統化工作流程為所有團隊提供正確之基礎，使其得以對齊目標、計畫與追蹤工作、協調跨部門之工作流程、釋放組織內之知識，並為本公司雲端客戶，將 AI 置於工作執行之核心 – 使人類與 AI 同事得以透過一單一、受治理之系統化工作流程進行協作。

Atlassian 雲端平台為我們的雲端應用產品組合提供基礎，使我們能夠為所有應用程式、代理與團隊提供統一的體驗、標準化的資料與共同的企業基礎設施。其設計目的是透過跨產品體驗與靈活的整合，打破資訊孤島，並確保資料保持安全、合規、私密與可用，並透過企業級的集中管理視圖與控制功能。此平台可提供現代化且連線的體驗，包括團隊、工具、工作流程與資料，並包含如人工智慧、搜尋與自動化等功能。完整的資料模型，即 Teamwork Graph，統一並標準化 Atlassian 應用程式、第三方工具與團隊的資料，提供豐富的組織脈絡，以驅動人工智慧代理與跨產品工作流程。

Atlassian 雲端平台的基礎設施層是專為企業客戶的不斷演進需求而設計，提供效能、規模、可靠性、安全性、合規性與私密性。此基礎設施提供安全的企業級基礎，支援大規模環境，確保資料保護，並提供集中管理與控制功能。此強固的基礎設施使 Atlassian 能夠持續推出新功能，支援大規模的人工智慧工作負載，並維持所有云端應用程式的高可用性與合規性標準。基礎設施層包含我們的 AI Gateway，提供跨多種人工智慧模型的智能路由，以優化不同工作負載的效能、成本與延遲，使我們能以無廠牌依賴的企業級方式提供人工智慧功能。
Atlassian 雲端平台的 Teamwork Graph 層為一個智能且統一的資料層，連結 Atlassian 與非 Atlassian 工具的脈絡化團隊資料。它將目標、知識、團隊與工作的關係進行圖像化，提供細膩的脈絡以強化跨產品體驗，加速、對齊並優化組織內的工作。

此組織脈絡是有效人工智慧代理與自動化工作流程的關鍵驅動因素。隨著人工智慧模型逐漸商品化，它們運作的脈絡品質決定了輸出結果的品質。Teamwork Graph 為人工智慧代理，無論是由 Atlassian、我們的用戶、客戶或第三方所建置，提供所需的關係導向企業脈絡，以產生準確、相關且可操作的結果。與一般用途的資料倉儲不同，Teamwork Graph 記錄了人、專案、目標與決策在團隊內與跨團隊之間的連接方式，使代理能透過已建立的關係進行操作，而非從頭發現。

Teamwork Graph 具有自我強化特性：它隨著每個工作流程、整合與互動而變得更豐富，包括來自第三方代理的互動，這些代理透過開放協議如 Model Context Protocol（"MCP"）與我們的命令列介面（"CLI"）進行連接。此開放性強化了圖像，因為外部代理既會使用也會貢獻組織脈絡，每次互動都使資料層更加深入。Teamwork Graph 的價值隨時間推移而累積，當客戶在 Atlassian 環境中增加更多工作流程、資料來源與應用程式時，其價值會不斷提升。
Rovo 是 Atlassian 的人工智慧產品，專為團隊協作而非個人生產力而設計。透過 Teamwork Graph 來驅動，Rovo 提供具組織脈絡的人工智慧功能——即人、專案、目標與知識之間的關係——以在企業的連線工作流程中提供準確、相關且可操作的結果。Rovo 包含四種平台功能：

paragraphs: 本年度報告表 10-K 的此部分討論本公司於財務年度 2026 與 2025 的財務狀況與營運成果，以及 2026 與 2025 年度之間的年對年比較，並依照美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）進行說明。有關 2024 財務年度的財務狀況與營運成果，以及 2025 與 2024 年度之間的年對年比較之說明，未包含於本年度報告表 10-K 中，可參閱本公司 2025 財務年度年度報告表 10-K 中 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 部分，於第二部分，第 7 項中，於 2025 年 8 月 15 日登記。
您應配合本公司合併財務報表與相關附註，閱讀以下對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析。如 "前瞻性陳述" 部分所述，以下討論與分析包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，以及假設，若這些假設未能實現或證明為錯誤，可能導致本公司結果與這些前瞻性陳述所表達或暗示者有重大差異。導致此種差異的因素包括，但不僅限於以下所列因素，以及 "風險因素" 部分於第一部分，第 1A 項中所討論的相關因素。
本公司使命為啟發每一個團隊的潛能。
Atlassian 的團隊協作軟體使組織得以透過一系統化的工作流程，將所有團隊串聯，從而實現大規模的生產力。

我們深具連結性的應用程式、AI 代理人與 Collections 系列產品，各自擁有明確的價值主張，為軟體團隊、IT 運維與支援團隊、領導與業務團隊提供解決方案。作為一家以 AI 為首的公司，我們已將 AI 能力嵌入至我們平台的每個層面，使組織能有效協調人類與 AI 同事之間的工作。這些應用程式、代理人與 Collections 都建於 Atlassian Cloud 平台與資料模型之上：一個共同的技術基礎，可無縫串聯組織內的團隊、資訊、脈絡與工作流程。

我們主要透過訂閱費產生收入。訂閱收入主要來自於訂閱型安排所產生的費用，這些安排讓客戶獲得使用我們軟體應用程式的權利，於我們所提供的雲端基礎架構中（"雲端服務"）。我們也銷售針對我們 Data Center 產品（"Data Center 服務"）的內部部署型期滿授權協議，包含軟體於指定期間內的授權，以及與授權期間內捆綁的支援與維護服務。訂閱收入也包含我們首選支援服務的訂閱型協議。我們偶爾會對應用程式與產品服務、價格與價格方案進行調整，這可能會影響我們收入的成長率，以及我們的遞延收入餘額、未履行義務與客戶留存率。透過我們的雲端與 Data Center 服務，訂閱收入會產生一個龐大的持續性收入基礎。
2025 年 9 月，我們宣佈將終止 Data Center 服務的支援。自 2026 年 3 月起，我們不再向新客戶銷售期滿授權，並預計在 2028 年 3 月停止向現有客戶銷售期滿授權與擴充授權。除有限例外情況外，我們也計畫在 2029 年 3 月終止對內部部署版本產品的維護與支援服務。為支持那些面臨獨特需求或挑戰的客戶，我們將為某些客戶提供約三年的延長維護期。

在 2026 財務年度的第二季，我們完成了對 The Browser Company of New York Inc.（"BCNY"）與 A Software Company（"DX"）的收購。我們認為將這些技術整合至我們的服務中，將提升客戶價值。BCNY 已開發出一個為 AI 世代的 SaaS 應用程式優化設計的企業瀏覽器。DX 提供市場領先的工程智慧，為領導者提供數據驅動的洞察，以瞭解其投資如何幫助團隊加速與改善工作，並提升我們 Collections 中的服務價值。

本公司營運成果可能因全球經濟變動對本公司或客戶的影響而有所波動。本公司業務依賴於企業軟體應用程序的總體需求，特別是協作軟體解決方案的需求。本公司面臨來自總體經濟環境變動、通貨膨脹壓力、利率政策、貿易政策變更、政治不穩定及地緣政治緊張等風險與影響。本公司監測這些情況對本公司業務及財務結果的直接與間接影響。這些風險最終對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況的影響程度，將取決於未來發展，而未來發展目前無法預測。
在財務年度2026年第一季，本公司啟動了一項重整計畫，以減少因產品在能力、可及性、效能、穩定性及支援性方面提升而不再需要的容量。
在財務年度2026年第三季，本公司啟動另一項重整計畫，以加速建設AI時代的團隊合作未來。這包括自籌資金進一步投資於關鍵戰略優先事項，例如AI與企業銷售，重新組織團隊以更聚焦且快速地跨Atlassian System of Work進行行動，並優化長期運營效率與永續性。此計畫導致某些職位被裁撤，影響約本公司10%的員工。
這些行動的執行，包括現金支付終止就業與其他終止福利相關負債，截至2026年6月30日已 substantially 滿足。
因此，本公司於財務年度2026年計提總計$203.9百萬的終止就業與其他終止福利費用，並計提總計$1.4百萬的股票基於報酬費用，用以補償受影響員工。
此外，本公司已退出部分租賃不動產以優化不動產佔地，並已進入或計畫進入這些地點的次租賃協議。因此，本公司於財務年度2026年計提總計$80.0百萬的相關營運租賃權利使用資產及租賃改裝費用減損費用。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
本公司歷來快速成長，使評估未來前景變得困難，且我們可能無法維持營收成長率或在未來實現長遠的獲利能力。
我們所參與的市場競爭激烈，若我們無法有效競爭，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成損害。
我們的AI產品與投資可能無法成功，這可能會對本公司業務或財務結果造成不利影響。
我們在持續轉型業務以專注於雲端產品時，可能面臨挑戰。
我們在發展銷售團隊與銷售策略時，可能面臨挑戰。
本公司針對低接觸客戶的業務模式部分建立於高交易量與自然擴張之上。若此模式無法有效運作，將可能對本公司業務與營運結果造成損害。
若我們無法與解決方案夥伴建立並維持成功的關係，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成損害。
若無法提供高品質的產品支援，將可能損害與客戶的關係，並對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成損害。
我們的營業收入主要來自 Jira、Confluence 及 Jira Service Management。
併購、戰略投資或合作關係可能幹擾本公司業務，且我們可能無法成功整合併購事項或實現這些交易預期的效益。
若我們無法將產品應用範圍擴展至軟體開發者以外的領域，將可能影響本公司業務成長的能力。
若我們無法維持並提升品牌，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成損害。
若我們無法有效管理成長，將可能對本公司業務及營運結果造成損害。
若 Atlassian Marketplace 未能持續成功，將可能對本公司業務及營運結果造成損害。
資訊科技、智慧財產權及資料安全與隱私權相關風險
與本公司資訊科技及基礎建設相關之中斷或效能問題，可能對本公司業務及營運成果造成損害。
paragraphs: 本公司業務所涉及之風險與不確定性之說明如下。請謹慎考量這些風險與不確定性，並與本年度10-K形式年度報告中所包含之其他資訊，以及本公司其他公開申報文件一併考量。若任何上述風險與不確定性實際發生，本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果可能與本年度10-K形式年度報告及其他公開申報文件中所包含之計畫、預測及其他前瞻性陳述有重大差異。此外，若任何下列風險與不確定性，或任何其他風險與不確定性實際發生，本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果可能受到重大影響。

本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性，包括本節標題為「風險因素」所強調之風險，以及以下摘要說明。本公司有各種類型之風險，包括與本公司業務及產業相關之風險、與資訊科技相關之風險、智慧財產權相關之風險、資料安全與隱私權相關之風險、與法律、法規、會計及稅務事項相關之風險、與本公司A類普通股之所有權相關之風險、與本公司負債相關之風險，以及一般性風險，這些風險在下文中將有更詳細說明。因此，本風險因素摘要並未包含所有對您可能重要的資訊，請您將本風險因素摘要與隨後本摘要所附之更詳細風險與不確定性說明，以及本年度10-K形式年度報告中其他地方所載之資訊一併閱讀。這些風險包括但不限於以下內容：
•本公司歷史上的快速成長使評估未來前景變得困難，且本公司可能無法維持營收成長率或在未來實現長期獲利。
•本公司參與之市場競爭激烈，若本公司無法有效競爭，則本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況可能受到損害。
•本公司之AI產品與投資可能無法成功，這可能會對本公司業務或財務結果造成不利影響。
•本公司在持續轉型業務以專注於雲端產品時，可能面臨挑戰。
